column2: [intro]
The other kids would watch me play,
With my drum, I'd dance away.
I made a noise, so proud and bright,
I wanted to dazzle with all my might.
I rented a drum, made of plastic,
From the toy library, it was fantastic.
I beat on it, felt like a king,
A real musician, joy to bring.
Parents smiled with eyes aglow,
At my excitement, my cheerful show.
I was their sunshine, their little clown,
With my drum, I turned the seasons around.
My plastic drum, so vibrant and clear,
It turned heads and brought cheer.
I kept the beat with a heart so light,
A moment of joy, so sweet and bright.
[solo]
I rented a drum, made of plastic,
From the toy library, it was fantastic.
I beat on it, felt like a king,
A real musician, joy to bring.
[outro]
